one_liner: Ask a question, get a cited answer from the real docs — then watch the answered procedure execute live on-chain.
what_it_does: Ask it how to do something and it answers straight from the official documentation, labeling every claim by its source. The interactive panel then executes the answered procedure live on Pharos mainnet via the Chain MCP — read-only calls, no broadcasts. Separately, the agent's own prior run executed 2 real dust transactions on the Atlantic testnet, all linked below.
